scope: Public-data research only; no changes to the shipping audio models; no phone accuracy claim
features: Normalize each mono recording by RMS, resample to 2000 Hz, compute 24 log-power bands from 20-950 Hz over 1-second windows with half-second hop; aggregate mean and standard deviation plus four spectral/time summary statistics. At most first 60 seconds.

normal_abnormal.split_limit: Release has no reliable person mapping in REFERENCE.csv; source-held-out is not proof of patient independence. Check exact waveform duplicates across split and existing CirCor before reporting external independence.
normal_abnormal.model: RandomForestClassifier, 240 trees, max_depth=10, min_samples_leaf=3, class_weight=balanced_subsample, random_state=20261115

valves.exclude: Any patient with a non-binary target, including patient_022; exclude all their recordings
valves.split: Order patients by sha256('heart-echo-valves-20261115:'+patient_id), first floor(0.8*N) train, remaining test; no model selection or threshold tuning on test
valves.input: Per-patient mean and standard deviation of the eight recording feature vectors. Filenames, diagnosis tokens and demographic fields are not inputs.
valves.model: Four separate RandomForestClassifier models with same fixed parameters as normal_abnormal; one per condition
valves.baseline: Per-condition majority training label; allows multiple conditions per patient
valves.limit: Small single-center stethoscope cohort, eight recordings required, not single-phone recording diagnosis

report: Per-class TP/FN/FP/TN and recall, specificity, precision, F1
Errors, exclusions, source mismatch and duplicate checks
No adaptive tuning after test results
